comparison.objective: Join two leg links by snapping a stud into a sprung jaw; candidate commissions an adjustable shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual link alignment and snap insertion versus tool insertion, collar rotation, counterhold and dynamic-response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Stud centered and tongue latched after release versus two non-bottoming stops with the collar relocked and stable.
comparison.reason: A one-time snap joint tests assembly alignment, not iterative damping calibration. Candidate omits numeric rebound, overload, drift and tightening limits.
